verdict.rationale: Chroma is Apache 2.0 licensed and can be run locally or self-hosted, meaning users are not locked into a proprietary cloud and own their underlying data store (chroma-docs-9, chroma-docs-15). However, there is no explicit documentation of a dedicated 'export all data' tool/API or a defined open interchange format for bulk export, only general self-host/local-run capability.  missing for 10: explicit data-export/import API or CLI command, documented open export format (e.g. JSON/parquet dump), and independent confirmation that migrating away from Chroma Cloud preserves all data losslessly.
